# `aitbc operations governance execute`

Execute a passed governance proposal on the blockchain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations governance execute [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal id. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations governance execute --proposal-id <proposal_id>
```
